# Value input markup reference

Range controls, numeric input, progress indicators, calendar, date, and color pickers.

### Calendar

Receiver: `Calendar`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindSelectedDate(ObservableValue<DateTime?> source)` | `bind SelectedDate` | Binds the selected date to an observable value. |
| `BindSelectedDate(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, DateTime?> convert, Func<DateTime?, TSource> convertBack = null)` | `bind SelectedDate` | Binds the selected date to a converted observable value. |
| `DisplayDate(DateTime value)` | `DisplayDate` | Sets the month/year currently displayed. |
| `DisplayMode(CalendarMode value)` | `DisplayMode` | Sets the display mode (Month, Year, Decade). |
| `FirstDayOfWeek(DayOfWeek value)` | `FirstDayOfWeek` | Sets the first day of the week. |
| `IsTodayHighlighted(bool value = true)` | `IsTodayHighlighted` | Sets whether today's date is highlighted. |
| `OnDisplayModeChanged(Action<CalendarMode> handler)` | `event DisplayModeChanged` | Subscribes handler to DisplayModeChanged. Raised when DisplayMode changes. |
| `OnSelectedDateChanged(Action<DateTime?> handler)` | `event SelectedDateChanged` | Subscribes handler to SelectedDateChanged. Raised when SelectedDate changes (keyboard navigation or click). |
| `SelectedDate(DateTime? value)` | `SelectedDate` | Sets the selected date. |

### RangeBase

Receiver: `RangeBase` and derived types (`where T : RangeBase`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `LargeChange(double value)` | `LargeChange` | Sets the increment for large changes. |
| `Maximum(double value)` | `Maximum` | Sets the maximum value. |
| `Minimum(double value)` | `Minimum` | Sets the minimum value. |
| `OnValueChanged(Action<double> handler)` | `event ValueChanged` | Subscribes handler to ValueChanged. Occurs when the value changes. |
| `Range(double minimum, double maximum)` | `Minimum`, `Maximum` | Sets Minimum and Maximum. |
| `SmallChange(double value)` | `SmallChange` | Sets the increment for small changes. |
